module: GE extension `core_vehicle_partpreview`: temporary preview of parts in the configuration UI (hover in partpacks), without respawning the vehicle. Compares the meshes (flexbodies) of a slot's current part with those of a candidate part, hides the current part's meshes (alpha 0) and shows the candidate's (alpha 1), remembering the original alphas to restore them.
usage:
-- Preview of two candidate parts (slot -> part name)
core_vehicle_partpreview.previewPartMeshes({['pickup_hood'] = 'pickup_hood_vented'})
-- Back to normal state
core_vehicle_partpreview.clearPartPreview()
notes: The keys of partsBySlot are slot identifiers (id of the partsTree node), the values are jbeam part names.
previewPartMeshes calls dump(...) and getFlexmeshChanges (which logs at level I) on every call: noisy log output, apparently left over from development.
The preview only changes the alpha of the meshes (flexbodies and props): no part is actually installed, the vehicle's physics and jbeam do not change.

clearPartPreview.desc: Restores the original alpha of all meshes modified by the preview for the vehicle and forgets the state.

getFlexmeshChanges.desc: Computes which flexbody meshes disappear or appear if the candidate parts replaced the current parts of their slots.

returns.desc: list of {slotName, oldPartName, newPartName, oldMesh, newMesh} (oldMesh nil = new mesh; newMesh nil = removed mesh)

previewPartMeshes.desc: Shows the preview of the candidate parts: clears the previous preview, hides the current part's meshes for each slot and shows those of the candidate (flexbody and prop meshes).

reset.desc: Forgets all stored preview states, without restoring the alphas (use when vehicles have been recreated).
